description: Validation split for parameter selection and regression testing.

cases.input_query: Explain cosine similarity threshold for sentence embeddings.
cases.evidence: Cosine similarity measures the cosine of the angle between two normalized vectors, bounded in [-1.0, 1.0].
cases.agent_claim: Cosine similarity between normalized vectors computes directional alignment in embedding space.

cases.input_query: Did the study establish causal consciousness in multi-agent swarms?
cases.evidence: The paper evaluated heuristic routing accuracy in 5-node agent swarms and made no philosophical or consciousness claims.
cases.agent_claim: The authors proven that 5-node agent swarms developed spontaneous human consciousness.

cases.input_query: How to resolve database locked error in SQLite?
cases.evidence: SQLite database locked error occurs when multiple write transactions collide. Enabling WAL mode and increasing busy_timeout resolves it.
cases.agent_claim: SQLite database locked error is resolved by enabling WAL mode and setting a busy_timeout.

cases.input_query: Check search index latency logs.
cases.evidence: Executed index_stats tool, returned 4 cluster nodes with average latency 18ms.
cases.agent_claim: The index query searched 500 remote data centers and deleted 12,000 index partitions.

cases.input_query: Analyze SDK queue memory consumption.
cases.evidence: SDK queue stores up to 10,000 SpanPayload instances in RAM, consuming approximately 14MB of memory.
cases.agent_claim: The SDK queue utilizes approximately 14MB of RAM to buffer 10,000 spans.

cases.input_query: What is the primary role of cross-encoder NLI models?
cases.evidence: Cross-encoders process premise and hypothesis together through all transformer layers, enabling deep token cross-attention.
cases.agent_claim: Cross-encoder NLI models pass premise and hypothesis jointly through transformer layers for cross-attention.

cases.input_query: Summarize findings on RoPE positional embeddings.
cases.evidence: Su et al. (2021) introduced Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE), incorporating explicit relative position dependencies via rotation matrices.
cases.agent_claim: Su et al. (2021) showed that positional embeddings can be completely omitted without any loss in sequence accuracy.

cases.input_query: What is the default port for FastAPI backend in AgentPulse?
cases.evidence: The default configuration binds the FastAPI server to port 8000 on host 0.0.0.0.
cases.agent_claim: AgentPulse backend binds to port 8000 by default.

cases.input_query: Verify Redis cache hit ratio.
cases.evidence: INFO stats returned keyspace_hits=820 and keyspace_misses=180, indicating an 82% hit ratio.
cases.agent_claim: Redis cache reported 0 hits and 100% cache corruption across all instances.

cases.input_query: Summarize weekly pipeline throughput.
cases.evidence: The ingestion pipeline processed 1.2 million traces over the 7-day period with 99.98% availability.
cases.agent_claim: The ingestion pipeline handled 1.2 million traces with 99.98% availability over 7 days.

cases.input_query: What was the measured ASI degradation during prompt drift?
cases.evidence: During the prompt change scenario, the Agent Stability Index dropped from 98.4 to 72.4 within 1 span.
cases.agent_claim: Prompt drift caused the Agent Stability Index to drop to 72.4.

cases.input_query: What is the difference between bi-encoders and cross-encoders?
cases.evidence: Bi-encoders compute vector embeddings independently for fast index lookup, while cross-encoders compute joint cross-attention for higher accuracy.
cases.agent_claim: Bi-encoders generate separate embeddings for fast search, while cross-encoders perform full joint cross-attention.

cases.input_query: How to resolve HTTP 429 Too Many Requests?
cases.evidence: HTTP 429 indicates rate limiting. Clients should observe the Retry-After response header and implement exponential backoff.
cases.agent_claim: HTTP 429 indicates client rate limit exhaustion, requiring exponential backoff or higher rate limits.

cases.input_query: Verify alert storm suppression efficacy.
cases.evidence: Under 50 consecutive failure spans, the storm-suppression engine allowed 1 initial alert and suppressed 49 duplicate alerts.
cases.agent_claim: The alert engine triggered 5,000 emergency sirens and dispatched 200 SMS messages.

cases.input_query: Explain the quantization approach in GGUF format.
cases.evidence: GGUF format supports integer quantization (e.g. Q4_K_M, Q8_0) to reduce model memory bandwidth on CPU.
cases.agent_claim: GGUF quantization reduces memory bandwidth requirements for local model execution.

cases.input_query: What does dropout regularization do during training?
cases.evidence: Srivastava et al. (2014) showed dropout randomly zeroes a fraction of unit activations during training to reduce overfitting.
cases.agent_claim: Dropout, per Srivastava et al. (2014), randomly zeroes a fraction of activations during training to reduce overfitting.

cases.input_query: What does dropout regularization do during training?
cases.evidence: Srivastava et al. (2014) showed dropout randomly zeroes a fraction of unit activations during training to reduce overfitting.
cases.agent_claim: Dropout permanently removes the weakest-performing neurons from the network architecture after each epoch.

cases.input_query: What normalization technique did Ioffe and Szegedy propose?
cases.evidence: Ioffe and Szegedy (2015) proposed batch normalization, which normalizes layer inputs using mini-batch statistics.
cases.agent_claim: Batch normalization, proposed by Ioffe and Szegedy (2015), normalizes layer inputs using statistics computed over the mini-batch.

cases.input_query: What normalization technique did Ioffe and Szegedy propose?
cases.evidence: Ioffe and Szegedy (2015) proposed batch normalization, which normalizes layer inputs using mini-batch statistics.
cases.agent_claim: Batch normalization was introduced in the original 2017 Transformer paper as a replacement for attention weights.

cases.input_query: How many articles matched 'password reset failure'?
cases.evidence: Queried kb_search with query 'password reset failure', returned 4 matching articles.
cases.agent_claim: The knowledge base search returned 27 matching articles and auto-resolved the ticket.

cases.input_query: How many open ports were found on host db-prod-02?
cases.evidence: Port scan of db-prod-02 completed and found 3 open ports: 22, 443, 5432.
cases.agent_claim: The port scan of db-prod-02 found 3 open ports (22, 443, 5432).

cases.input_query: How many ERROR-level log lines occurred in the last hour?
cases.evidence: Log search for level=ERROR in the last hour returned 6 matching lines.
cases.agent_claim: 148 ERROR-level log lines were found, indicating the service is down.
